logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-05 assurance handover. Left panel: the measured energy ladder redrawn at an explicit fixed scale of 5 px per kWh — P2 15 kWh, P3 24, P1 44, P4 64 — with gridlines at 20/40/60 kWh and the successive gaps 9, 20, 20 kWh stated beneath, correcting the off-scale left figure delivered in this round's A brief. Right panel: a six-step next-analyst checklist covering recompute-from-table screening, energy re-ranking with gap verification, chart-scale auditing against bar labels, the P4 zero-spare-slot recheck, open-question logging (variance, cost, delivery) and the final lowest-energy ballot. The pair lets the next analyst audit rendered pixels against the trusted table in one pass and repair the recurring figure-scale defect flagged by both the main review and B's memo. No decorative content; every element serves the WO-05 selection analysis.
